notes.homophily_property: Adjusted homophily (assortativity) satisfies maximal agreement and asymptotic constant baseline; empty class tolerant; monotonicity holds for sufficiently large values.
notes.li_property: LI has maximal agreement and tends to 0 under configuration-model null; complements homophily by distinguishing heterophilous patterns.
notes.comparability: Reporting hadj and LI together enables fair cross-dataset comparison.
notes.limitations: Small n=25 yields higher variance in global stats; edges are sampled i.i.d. per SBM-like scheme; connectivity not enforced.
